subject: Knoob Fights
author: SUFFUR
body:
I must say in your room, the Knoobs were too busy fighting each other, to race. If I didn't think it was a ploy for us to go back and investigate, then they would have jumped us and won the race, maybe, lol. But it was a good night except for the can't connects, to any Burnout Server?

Some tight racing was had, that does end in tears, crocodile tears, but I will claim some Revenge in the next couple of dayz.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Getting Kicked
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: I hear where your coming from.....i suppose you just get used to the kicking but being honest with you there is alot more of it recently....why?....god only knows its silly why kick someone for having a low rank?.....when i first started if anyone came in my rooms with a low rank id launch faster than you could blink...lmao....i just dont understand this game anymore its changed and not for the better.....im sick of getting kicked so much i just do my own rooms now.....but then i have problems filling it because they see the rank and leave....RANK RANK RANK.....why does it matter to many so people?.......:)
